title: 第五章 不死不休第六章 这是宝贝
content_zh:
“你又输了！”
一片死寂之中，姜云的声音再次响起。
轻飘飘的四个字，却如同四道惊雷，重重的劈落在每个人的心中，尤其是那个“又”字，对于风无忌来说，更是赤裸裸的羞辱。
“好样的，云娃子！”
“杀了他，杀了他！”
回过神来的姜村众人顿时沸腾了起来，一个个欢呼大叫，甚至希望姜云杀了风无忌。
一次偷袭，一次输了不认账，谁都看得出来，风无忌为人极为阴险，如果放了他，后患无穷，再加上他毕竟破坏了莽山的规矩，就算杀了他，风村的人也无话可说。
“姜云，你敢！”
风凌却是急了，大吼一声已经带着所有风村人冲了过来，而姜云微一沉吟之后，匕首一收，但是另一只手却是出拳如风。
R首：*发%f
“砰”的一声，拳头狠狠的砸在了风无忌的胸膛之上，将他整个人给直接砸的飞了出去，而姜云也趁机脚下一点，身形退后数丈。
“姜云！”
看到风无忌竟然被姜云一拳砸飞，风凌的眼珠都快要瞪出眼眶，甚至于都不去接风无忌，而是直接向着姜云冲了过来。
这个时候，姜万里终于开口说话道：“风凌，你要是再敢乱来，在这莽山之中，就算轮回宗也护不住你们！”
风凌的身形硬生生的刹住了，虽然他心有不甘，但是却也知道姜万里的威胁并非是在危言耸听。
风无忌破坏莽山规矩在前，姜云杀了他是应该的，而如果他们再出手的话，那么等待他们的，将是十万莽山所有村落的联手攻击。
就算轮回宗有天大的势力，也不会仅仅为了一个内门弟子而得罪整个十万莽山。
“你们给我等着，走！”
在确定风无忌仅仅只是断了几根肋骨，并无性命大碍之后，风凌恶狠狠的瞪了一眼姜村众人，尤其是姜云，这才大手一挥，带着风村众人转身离开，而风无忌也已经被人抬了起来。
可就在这时，异变再起。

“咔擦”一声，风无忌忽然双手用力，掰断了刚才姜云射给他的那支箭，死死的盯着姜云，眼神之中充满了怨毒之色。
莽山的规矩，拔出对方射出的箭，是接受了挑战，那么掰断了箭，则代表着——不死不休！
显然，风无忌和姜云之间，不管岁月如何变迁，他们之中必然会有一人死在对方的手中。
“姜云，五年之后，我必杀你！你若敢逃，我就让你们姜村陪葬！”
虽然风无忌的威胁之语仍然回荡在村中，但随着风村的人终于消失不见，姜村众人也是长出一口气，至少暂时这件事是告一段落了。
放松下来的众人立刻将姜云围了起来，姜穆伸出拳头，用力的捶打了一下姜云的肩膀道：“小子，看不出来，藏的还挺深啊！”
姜雷挤眉弄眼道：“就是，云弟，从没见你出手，没想到你这么厉害，那以后，咱们可要多多切磋切磋了。”
今天姜云的表现，实在是出乎了众人的意料，也带给了他们极大的惊喜，毕竟姜云是他们的亲人，他们当然愿意看到自己的亲人强大。
“好了，都散了吧！”姜万里挥了挥手道：“云娃子，跟我回去！”
此刻的姜云已经恢复了平时的模样，冲着众人笑了笑，便跟在姜万里的身后，回到了那间小屋。
content_en:
"You lost again!"
In the dead silence, Jiang Yun's voice sounded again.
The four words were light and fluttering, but like four thunders, they struck everyone's heart heavily, especially the word "again", which was a naked humiliation for Feng Wuji.
"Well done, Yunwazi!"
"Kill him, kill him!"
After coming back to their senses, everyone in Jiang Village suddenly became excited, cheering and shouting, and even hoped that Jiang Yun would kill Feng Wuji.
A sneak attack, a failure to admit defeat, everyone can see that Feng Wuji is extremely insidious. If he is let go, there will be endless troubles. In addition, after all, he has broken the rules of Mangshan. Even if he is killed, the people of Feng Village will have nothing to say.
"Jiang Yun, how dare you!"
Feng Ling was anxious, and with a roar he rushed over with all the people in Feng Village. After Jiang Yun thought for a moment, he retracted his dagger, but punched like the wind with his other hand.

With a "bang", his fist hit Feng Wuji's chest hard, sending his whole body flying out. Jiang Yun also took the opportunity to step back a few feet.
"Jiang Yun!"
Seeing Feng Wuji being punched away by Jiang Yun, Feng Ling's eyes nearly popped out of his sockets. He didn't even pick up Feng Wuji, but rushed towards Jiang Yun directly.
At this time, Jiang Wanli finally spoke: "Feng Ling, if you dare to act recklessly again, not even the Samsara Sect can protect you in this Mangshan Mountain!"
Feng Ling's figure stopped abruptly. Although he was unwilling to do so, he also knew that Jiang Wanli's threat was not alarmist.
Feng Wuji broke Mangshan's rules first, so Jiang Yun should kill him. If they take action again, what awaits them will be a joint attack from all the villages in Shiwanmangshan.
Even if the Samsara Sect was extremely powerful, they would not offend the entire Shiwanmang Mountain just for one inner disciple.
"Just wait for me and let's go!"
After confirming that Feng Wuji had only broken a few ribs and was not in serious danger, Feng Ling glared at everyone in Jiang Village, especially Jiang Yun, and then waved his hand and turned away with everyone in Feng Village. Feng Wuji had also been lifted up.
But at this moment, something strange happened again.
With a "click" sound, Feng Wuji suddenly used both hands to break off the arrow that Jiang Yun had shot at him. He stared at Jiang Yun with a look of resentment in his eyes.
According to the rules of Mangshan, pulling out the arrow shot by the opponent means accepting the challenge, and breaking the arrow means that you will fight until death!
Obviously, between Feng Wuji and Jiang Yun, no matter how the years change, one of them will definitely die in the hands of the other.
"Jiang Yun, after five years, I will kill you! If you dare to escape, I will let you Jiang Village be buried with you!"
Although Feng Wuji's threatening words still echoed in the village, as the people in Feng Village finally disappeared, everyone in Jiang Village breathed a sigh of relief. At least for the time being, the matter was over.
The people who relaxed immediately surrounded Jiang Yun. Jiang Mu stretched out his fist, hit Jiang Yun on the shoulder hard and said: "Boy, you can't tell, it's quite hidden!"
Jiang Lei winked and said, "That's right, Brother Yun, I've never seen you take action before, and I didn't expect you to be so powerful. From now on, we will have a lot of competition."
Jiang Yun's performance today really exceeded everyone's expectations and brought them a great surprise. After all, Jiang Yun was their relative, and of course they wanted to see their relative become strong.
"Okay, let's all disperse!" Jiang Wanli waved his hand and said: "Yunwazi, come back with me!"
At this moment, Jiang Yun had returned to his usual appearance, smiled at everyone, and followed Jiang Wanli back to the hut.
